恐龙机器人鄙视弱点，会用破损的装甲刺穿敌人的方块。

格挡对手：如果格挡对手破甲，恐龙机器人会通过格挡造成 {{var_14}} 点更多伤害，并有 {{var_15}} 几率发动不可格挡攻击。
abilities.desc_en:
Survival of the Fittest
Dinobot despises weakness and will pierce the blocks of enemies with broken armor.
Blocking Opponents: If a Blocking opponent is Armor Broken, Dinobot deals {{var_14}} more damage through their Block and has a {{var_15}} chance to deliver an Unblockable Attack.
